items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The launch command is read inside a route and the untouched response passed on; installed before the modal click; the report step says whether it was captured.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A failed fetch continues the request; a non-JSON body is delivered and reported as not captured.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Test harness only; the command text is never printed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Fake-route unit test: URL pattern, other verbs, capture, same response object, non-JSON, network failure.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Stays in launch-recovery.ts next to the watch that uses it.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumer of the WebUI /launch response shape {task, commands}; the fake mirrors it, the page still receives the same response.
